python.code:
from contextlib import contextmanager
@contextmanager
def timer():
    import time
    s = time.time()
    yield
    print(f"耗时 {time.time()-s:.2f}s")
with timer():
    sum(range(10**7))
python.content: with 语句保证资源（文件、锁、连接）用完后正确释放，即使中间抛异常。自定义上下文管理器只需实现 __enter__ / __exit__，或用 contextlib.contextmanager 装饰器。
python.title: with 语句与上下文管理器

go.title: 多返回值与错误处理

sql.code:
SELECT age, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM users
GROUP BY age
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY n DESC;
sql.content: GROUP BY 按列分组聚合，HAVING 是分组后的过滤（WHERE 是分组前）。聚合函数：COUNT/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX。SELECT 中非聚合列必须出现在 GROUP BY 里。
sql.title: GROUP BY 与 HAVING
